title: archived and restored a task on taskflow-v2-0-0.vercel.app
source_description: User can view archived tasks on the Archive page and restore them to the active list
expected_result:
Created a new task titled "Archive demo task" with due date 2026-05-20 using the Add a task form.
Archived the "Archive demo task" item from the main task list.
Opened the Archive view and confirmed "Archive demo task" appeared in the archived list.
Restored "Archive demo task" from the Archive view.
Returned to the main task list and verified "Archive demo task" was visible again in the active tasks list.
kane_objective: On https://taskflow-v2-0-0.vercel.app/ — Step 1 (SETUP): create a new task titled 'Archive demo task' with due date 2026-05-20 using the Add a task form. Step 2 (SETUP): on that task's row, click the Archive button to archive it. Step 3 (VERIFY): click the Archive link in the top navigation (or navigate to https://taskflow-v2-0-0.vercel.apparchive) and confirm 'Archive demo task' is listed there. Step 4 (VERIFY): click the Restore button next to that archived task. Step 5 (VERIFY): return to the main task list (navigate to https://taskflow-v2-0-0.vercel.app) and confirm 'Archive demo task' is back in the active list. Stop after the restored task is visible on the active list — do not delete or re-archive it.

title: navigated to a Taskflow tasks page on taskflow-v2-0-0.vercel.app
source_description: User visiting a URL with a malformed session ID (not the literal "default" and not a 32-character lowercase hex string) receives an HTTP 404 response
expected_result:
The run attempted to open a Taskflow “tasks” page using the link: https://taskflow-v2-0-0.vercel.app/s/not-a-valid-hex-uuid/tasks.
The page shown in the screenshots is a “Not Found” error page that says the requested URL was not found on the server, indicating the link/path is invalid or the workspace/session ID in the URL is not recognized.
Because the run landed on this error page, there were no tasks or normal page controls available to interact with, so it could not proceed with any further steps.
After the initial navigation, the remaining recorded steps failed due to missing step data (“step file not found”), so no additional actions were completed beyond loading the error page.
kane_objective: On https://taskflow-v2-0-0.vercel.app/s/not-a-valid-hex-uuid/tasks — Step 1 (VERIFY): the browser receives an HTTP 404 response (the page either renders a 404 error page or the browser shows a not-found state). Stop after the 404 is confirmed. Stay on the AUT — do NOT navigate to any kaneai-playground or ecommerce-playground site. Stop immediately once confirmed. Do not navigate further.

title: viewed the Session B task list on taskflow-v2-0-0.vercel.app
source_description: Tasks, archives, labels, and priorities created under one session are invisible and untouchable from any other session
expected_result:
Opened the Taskflow app and navigated to the Tasks page for Session B.
Checked the task list under Session B and it showed an empty state (“No tasks.”).
Confirmed Session B’s task list did not include the “Session A task,” verifying tasks are isolated between sessions.
kane_objective: On https://taskflow-v2-0-0.vercel.app/s/a1b2c3d4e5f60718293a4b5c6d7e8f90/tasks — Step 1 (SETUP): create a task titled 'Session A task' with no due date using the Add task form. Step 2 (VERIFY): confirm 'Session A task' appears in the list. Step 3 (NAVIGATE): change the URL to https://taskflow-v2-0-0.vercel.app/s/0fedcba987654321a1b2c3d4e5f60718/tasks to switch to a different session. Step 4 (VERIFY): confirm the task list under session B does NOT contain 'Session A task' — the list should either be empty or contain only tasks unique to session B. Stop after cross-session isolation is verified. Stay on the AUT — do NOT navigate to any kaneai-playground or ecommerce-playground site.
